tasks.label: C++: 编译并运行
tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" >nul 2>&1 & taskkill /F /IM outDebug.exe >nul 2>&1 & if not exist build mkdir build & g++ -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -g3 -O0 "${file}" -o "build\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" && "build\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"

tasks.label: C++: 仅编译
tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" >nul 2>&1 & taskkill /F /IM outDebug.exe >nul 2>&1 & if not exist build mkdir build & g++ -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -g3 -O0 "${file}" -o "build\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"
